name: A newly recorded real process retains the same identity across Buenos Aires and Berlin
Real start and command changes still fail identity checks; untagged identity stays unverifiable
A real blocking listener survives timezone changes without replacement and durably captures feedback
Unknown live legacy listener refuses replacement and retirement while preserving feedback and work
Every watcher arm, restart, stop and takeover mode preserves an unverifiable live owner
Daemon lifecycle commands refuse uncertain ownership without signalling or changing retained state
Readiness tolerates delayed identity publication and preserves the terminal after persistent uncertainty
Neither actor drains feedback or reclaims a grant with an unverifiable live owner
